review_style.value: Runs /walden-review, a skill trained on 6 months of personal PR comments, before reading any PR
review_style.quote: I always run it before ever reading a PR myself

also.quote: On the held-out eval set, it catches about 70% of the code issues I’d flagged.
Then when I go to review, I ask it to tell me what I should look at first
Humans should only look at PRs after an AI has already reviewed it.

Me: isn't this code hacky?
Devin Review: no ur code is hacky
Breaking PRs into stacks has been genuinely only of the greatest life hacks I learned (thanks to @ido_pesok)

signature.caption: trained on own PR comments
signature.why: Our pick: Devin hill-climbed a skill against six months of personal review comments with a held-out set, so a copy of the review runs first.
signature.quote: I got sick of reviewing code. So I made /walden-review.

also.quote: My favorite use for Devin isn’t even writing code. Every day, my Devin reads every customer report and escalates all the top feature requests to our eng team. Eyes everywhere.

archetype.why: He points Devin at a Slack channel, lets it split the work and launches a team of Devins.

signature_quote.value: I spend so much on tokens nowadays but have way more trust in my PRs.
signature_quote.more: Self-fixing autonomous agents is the future and its here
